meta.title: Solitaire — patience with cards, without ads
meta.description: Klondike, Spider and FreeCell solitaire with big, easy-to-read cards. By default every deal can be won; hints and undo are free and unlimited. No ads, no accounts, no tracking; works offline.

game.title: Klondike
game.tip: Tap a card: it goes where it fits best. Or drag it. Put every card on the four foundations, from the ace to the king.
game.stockTurn: Stock empty: tap to turn the waste over
game.turnedOver: The waste is turned over into the stock.
game.noPlace: {card}: there is no place for it now.
game.faceDown: This card is face down: it turns up when nothing lies on it.
game.fromHome: To bring a card back from the foundation, drag it.
game.deadEnd: No moves left that lead to the end.
game.finishNote: Every card is open: the rest can go home by itself.
game.newSure: Tap again to deal anew: this deal will count as played.

spider.title: Spider
spider.tip: Put a card on one a rank higher, of any suit. Only runs of one suit move together. Gather eight runs from the king down to the ace — they go home by themselves.
spider.emptyColumn: First put a card into the empty column — then the stock deals.
spider.dealt: A card dealt onto each column.
spider.notRun: {card}: only cards of one suit in order move together.
spider.unsureDeal: The game could not look all the way to the end; try dealing from the stock.
spider.rotate: Turn the phone — the cards get bigger (if the screen does not turn, switch on auto-rotate).
spider.fullscreenFailed: The screen could not be turned — turn the phone yourself.
spider.settingNote: With four suits, any deals as the cards fall: the game has no time to check them.

about.title: About the game
about.rules: Put every card on the four foundations, each suit from the ace to the king. In the columns, lay cards downwards in alternating colours (a red nine on a black ten); you can move several open cards in order together. Only a king goes to an empty column. A face-down card turns up when nothing lies on it. Tap the stock to turn cards; when it is empty, the waste turns over.
about.text: Solitaire without ads, accounts or tracking. Progress stays on this device. Works offline.
about.keys: Keyboard: arrows — move between cards and places, Enter or Space — like a tap, D — the stock, H — hint, Ctrl+Z — undo, F — finish, N — new deal, Esc — close.
